title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 18 · Biography of Pang De

text.en: Pang De followed Ma Teng in campaigns against the rebellious Qiang and Di tribes, repeatedly earning merit and rising to the rank of Colonel.
text.zht: 龐德隨馬騰征討叛亂的羌、氐部落，屢立戰功，漸升至校尉。
text.zhs: 庞德随马腾征讨叛乱的羌、氐部落，屡立战功，渐升至校尉。

text.en: Ma Chao was Ma Teng's son.

Pang De followed Ma Teng's son Ma Chao against Guo Yuan and Gao Gan at Pingyang, serving as vanguard in routing their forces; he was appointed Gentleman-General and enfeoffed as Capital Neighbourhood Marquis.
text.zht: 龐德隨馬騰之子馬超於平陽抵禦郭援、高幹，為軍鋒大破其軍，拜中郎將，封都亭侯。
text.zhs: 庞德随马腾之子马超于平阳抵御郭援、高干，为军锋大破其军，拜中郎将，封都亭侯。

text.en: When Ma Teng was summoned to court, Pang De remained attached to Ma Chao; after Cao Cao defeated Ma Chao south of the Wei River, Pang De fled with him to Hanyang and then followed him to Hanzhong, serving under Zhang Lu.
text.zht: 馬騰徵為衞尉後，龐德留屬馬超；太祖破馬超於渭南，龐德隨其亡入漢陽，後又隨其奔漢中，投靠張魯。
text.zhs: 马腾征为卫尉后，庞德留属马超；太祖破马超于渭南，庞德随其亡入汉阳，后又随其奔汉中，投靠张鲁。

text.en: Guo Yuan was Zhong Yao's nephew.
Pang De personally beheaded Guo Yuan after routing his forces at Pingyang.
text.zht: 龐德於平陽大破郭援軍後，親斬其首。
text.zhs: 庞德于平阳大破郭援军后，亲斩其首。

text.en: When Pang De realised the head he had taken was Guo Yuan's, Zhong Yao's own nephew, he apologised; Zhong Yao, weeping, told him a traitor to the state deserved no apology.
text.zht: 龐德得知所斬乃鍾繇之甥郭援，向他致歉；鍾繇卻流淚道，郭援雖是甥，然為國賊，不必致歉。
text.zhs: 庞德得知所斩乃钟繇之甥郭援，向他致歉；钟繇却流泪道，郭援虽是甥，然为国贼，不必致歉。

text.en: After Ma Chao's defeat, Pang De followed him to Hanzhong and served under Zhang Lu.
text.zht: 馬超兵敗後，龐德隨其至漢中，投靠張魯。
text.zhs: 马超兵败后，庞德随其至汉中，投靠张鲁。

text.en: When Cao Cao pacified Hanzhong, Pang De surrendered with the others; having long heard of his valour, Cao Cao appointed him General Who Champions Righteousness and enfeoffed him as Neighbourhood Marquis of Guanmen with three hundred households.
text.zht: 太祖平定漢中，龐德隨衆歸降；太祖素聞其驍勇，拜立義將軍，封關門亭侯，邑三百戶。
text.zhs: 太祖平定汉中，庞德随众归降；太祖素闻其骁勇，拜立义将军，封关门亭侯，邑三百户。

title.en: General Who Champions Righteousness, Neighbourhood Marquis of Guanmen

text.en: Despite suspicion from Fancheng's generals over his kinsman's presence in Hanzhong, Pang De vowed to kill Guan Yu himself rather than be killed by him, and wounded him in the forehead with an arrow in battle.
text.zht: 樊城諸將因其親族在漢中而頗疑之，龐德誓言寧可親手殺關羽，不願被關羽所殺，交戰中更射傷其額。
text.zhs: 樊城诸将因其亲族在汉中而颇疑之，庞德誓言宁可亲手杀关羽，不愿被关羽所杀，交战中更射伤其额。

text.en: When Cao Cao heard of Pang De's death, he grieved and wept, ennobled both of Pang De's sons as marquises, and Cao Pi later posthumously honoured him as Marquis Zhuang, the Valiant Marquis.
text.zht: 太祖聞龐德死訊，痛惜流涕，封其二子為列侯；文帝即位後，追諡龐德為壯侯。
text.zhs: 太祖闻庞德死讯，痛惜流涕，封其二子为列侯；文帝即位后，追谥庞德为壮侯。

text.en: Pang De joined Cao Ren in storming Wan and beheading the rebels Hou Yin and Wei Kai, then marched south with him to garrison Fancheng and campaign against Guan Yu.
text.zht: 龐德隨曹仁攻破宛城，斬侯音、衞開，其後南下屯駐樊城，共同征討關羽。
text.zhs: 庞德随曹仁攻破宛城，斩侯音、卫开，其后南下屯驻樊城，共同征讨关羽。

text.en: Pang Rou, Pang De's elder cousin, was then serving in Shu, which made Fancheng's generals deeply suspicious of Pang De.
text.zht: 龐柔是龐德的從兄，當時效力於蜀，因此樊城諸將對龐德頗為猜疑。
text.zhs: 庞柔是庞德的从兄，当时效力于蜀，因此樊城诸将对庞德颇为猜疑。

text.en: Pang De wounded Guan Yu in the forehead with an arrow in battle; riding a white horse, he became known among Guan Yu's troops as the "White Horse General," whom all stood in awe of.
text.zht: 龐德於交戰中射傷關羽額頭；因常乘白馬，關羽軍中稱其為「白馬將軍」，無不畏憚。
text.zhs: 庞德于交战中射伤关羽额头；因常乘白马，关羽军中称其为「白马将军」，无不畏惮。

text.en: After his overturned boat left him without a weapon, Pang De was captured but stood firm and refused to kneel; when Guan Yu offered to spare him if he surrendered, Pang De declared he would rather die a ghost of the state than live as a rebel's general, so Guan Yu had him killed.
text.zht: 船覆失去弓箭後，龐德被擒仍立而不跪；關羽許以不死勸降，龐德卻言寧為國家鬼，不為賊將，關羽遂將他殺害。
text.zhs: 船覆失去弓箭后，庞德被擒仍立而不跪；关羽许以不死劝降，庞德却言宁为国家鬼，不为贼将，关羽遂将他杀害。

text.en: When General Dong Heng sought to surrender amid the flood, Pang De had him seized and beheaded.
text.zht: 洪水中董衡欲降，龐德將他擒獲斬殺。
text.zhs: 洪水中董衡欲降，庞德将他擒获斩杀。

text.en: When retainer commander Dong Chao also sought to surrender, Pang De had him seized and beheaded alongside Dong Heng.
text.zht: 部曲將董超亦欲投降，龐德將他與董衡一併擒殺。
text.zhs: 部曲将董超亦欲投降，庞德将他与董衡一并擒杀。

text.en: As his arrows ran out and the floodwaters rose, Pang De told his commander Cheng He that a worthy general does not fear death, and that today was his day to die.
text.zht: 矢盡水漲之際，龐德對其將成何說，賢將不畏死以求生，今日便是他的死期。
text.zhs: 矢尽水涨之际，庞德对其将成何说，贤将不畏死以求生，今日便是他的死期。

text.en: Pang Hui was Pang De's son; bold and resolute like his father, he rose to become Commandant of the Capital and General, and was granted the rank of Marquis.
text.zht: 龐會是龐德之子，果烈有父風，官至中尉、將軍，獲封列侯。
text.zhs: 庞会是庞德之子，果烈有父风，官至中尉、将军，获封列侯。

era.zht: 建安二十三 - 二十四年
era.zhs: 建安二十三 - 二十四年

orig.zht: 龐悳字令明，[[南安狟道|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.93713305&lng=104.74344326&name=Huandao]]人也。少為郡吏州從事。初平中，從馬騰擊反羌叛氐。數有功，稍[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]至校尉。
orig.zhs: 庞悳字令明，[[南安狟道|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.93713305&lng=104.74344326&name=Huandao]]人也。少为郡吏州从事。初平中，从马腾击反羌叛氐。数有功，稍[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]至校尉。

vern.zht: 龐德字令明，是[[南安狟道|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.93713305&lng=104.74344326&name=Huandao]]人。年少時擔任過郡吏、州從事。初平年間，跟隨馬騰攻打反叛的羌人、氐人。多次立功，逐漸升遷到校尉。
vern.zhs: 庞德字令明，是[[南安狟道|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.93713305&lng=104.74344326&name=Huandao]]人。年少时担任过郡吏、州从事。初平年间，跟随马腾攻打反叛的羌人、氐人。多次立功，逐渐升迁到校尉。

passages.en: Pang De, courtesy name Lingming, was from [[Huandao, Nan'an|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.93713305&lng=104.74344326&name=Huandao]]. In his youth, he served as a commandery clerk and provincial Aide. During the Chuping era, he followed Ma Teng in campaigns against the rebellious Qiang and Di tribes. He repeatedly earned merit and was eventually [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to Colonel.

annotations.en: The character 狟 is pronounced like 桓 (huán).

orig.zht: 建安中，太祖討袁譚、尚於[[黎陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.68354088&lng=114.58305267&name=Liyang]]，譚遣郭援、高幹等略取[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，太祖使鍾繇率[[關中|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]諸將討之。悳隨騰子超拒援、幹於[[平陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.06263787&lng=111.39043883&name=Pingyang]]，悳為軍鋒，進攻援、幹，大破之，親斬援首。[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]]中郎將，封[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。
orig.zhs: 建安中，太祖讨袁谭、尚于[[黎阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.68354088&lng=114.58305267&name=Liyang]]，谭遣郭援、高幹等略取[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，太祖使钟繇率[[关中|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]诸将讨之。悳随腾子超拒援、干于[[平阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.06263787&lng=111.39043883&name=Pingyang]]，悳为军锋，进攻援、干，大破之，亲斩援首。[[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]]中郎将，封[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。

vern.zht: 建安年間，太祖在[[黎陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=35.68354088&lng=114.58305267&name=Liyang]]討伐袁譚、袁尚，袁譚派郭援、高幹等人攻取[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，太祖命鍾繇率領[[關中|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]諸將討伐他們。龐德隨馬騰的兒子馬超在[[平陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.06263787&lng=111.39043883&name=Pingyang]]抵禦郭援、高幹，龐德擔任先鋒，進攻郭援、高幹，大破敵軍，親自斬下郭援的首級。龐德被任命爲中郎將，封爲[[都亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。
vern.zhs: 建安年间，太祖在[[黎阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=35.68354088&lng=114.58305267&name=Liyang]]讨伐袁谭、袁尚，袁谭派郭援、高幹等人攻取[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]，太祖命钟繇率领[[关中|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]]诸将讨伐他们。庞德随马腾的儿子马超在[[平阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.06263787&lng=111.39043883&name=Pingyang]]抵御郭援、高幹，庞德担任先锋，进攻郭援、高幹，大破敌军，亲自斩下郭援的首级。庞德被任命为中郎将，封为[[都亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。

passages.en: During the Jian'an era, Cao Cao (posthumously honoured as Taizu, the Grand Progenitor) campaigned against Yuan Tan and Yuan Shang at [[Liyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=35.68354088&lng=114.58305267&name=Liyang]]. Yuan Tan sent Guo Yuan, Gao Gan, and others to seize [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]], whereupon Cao Cao ordered Zhong Yao to lead the generals from [[Inside the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-inside-the-pass-guanzhong]] against them. Pang De followed Ma Teng's son Ma Chao in opposing Guo Yuan and Gao Gan at [[Pingyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.06263787&lng=111.39043883&name=Pingyang]]. Serving as the army's vanguard, Pang De advanced to attack Guo Yuan and Gao Gan, utterly routed their forces, and personally beheaded Guo Yuan. He was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] Gentleman-General and enfeoffed as [[Capital Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]].

source.en: Weilüe / Brief History of Wei (Yu Huan)

annotations.zht: 《魏略》曰：悳手斬一級，不知是援。戰罷之後，衆人皆言援死而不得其首。援，鍾繇之甥。悳晚後於鞬中出一頭，繇見之而哭。悳謝繇，繇曰：「援雖我甥，乃國賊也。卿何謝之？」
annotations.zhs: 《魏略》曰：悳手斩一级，不知是援。战罢之后，众人皆言援死而不得其首。援，钟繇之甥。悳晚后于鞬中出一头，繇见之而哭。悳谢繇，繇曰：「援虽我甥，乃国贼也。卿何谢之？」

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：龐德親手斬殺一人，當時並不知道被斬的人是郭援。戰鬥結束之後，衆人都說郭援死了卻找不到他的首級。郭援是鍾繇的外甥，龐德在戰鬥結束一段時間後，從箭袋裏拿出了一個人頭，鍾繇看到後哭了。龐德向鍾繇謝罪。鍾繇說：“郭援雖然是我的外甥，但他是國家的賊寇，你爲何要向我道歉呢？”
vern.zhs: 《魏略》记载：庞德亲手斩杀一人，当时并不知道被斩的人是郭援。战斗结束之后，众人都说郭援死了却找不到他的首级。郭援是钟繇的外甥，庞德在战斗结束一段时间后，从箭袋里拿出了一个人头，钟繇看到后哭了。庞德向钟繇谢罪。钟繇说：“郭援虽然是我的外甥，但他是国家的贼寇，你为何要向我道歉呢？”

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Pang De personally beheaded an enemy, unaware that he was Guo Yuan. After the battle, everyone said that Guo Yuan had been killed, but his head could not be found. Guo Yuan was Zhong Yao's nephew. Later, when Pang De drew a head from his bow case, Zhong Yao wept at the sight of it. Pang De apologised, but Zhong Yao said, "Though Guo Yuan was my nephew, he was a traitor to the state. Why should you apologise?"

orig.zht: 後張白騎叛於[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.65035856&lng=110.90996505&name=Hongnong]]，悳復隨騰征之，破白騎於兩殽閒。每戰，常陷陣却敵，勇冠騰軍。後騰[[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]為衞尉，悳留屬超。太祖破超於[[渭|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=14]]南，悳隨超亡入[[漢陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=26.81209209&lng=104.61455673&name=Hanyang]]，保[[兾城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.70667265&lng=105.41239497&name=Ji]]。後復隨超奔[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，從張魯。太祖定[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，悳隨衆降。太祖素聞其驍勇，[[拜|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[立義將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-148]]，封關門[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，邑三百戶。
orig.zhs: 后张白骑叛于[[弘农|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.65035856&lng=110.90996505&name=Hongnong]]，悳复随腾征之，破白骑于两殽闲。每战，常陷阵却敌，勇冠腾军。后腾[[征|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]为衞尉，悳留属超。太祖破超于[[渭|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=14]]南，悳随超亡入[[汉阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=26.81209209&lng=104.61455673&name=Hanyang]]，保[[兾城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.70667265&lng=105.41239497&name=Ji]]。后复随超奔[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，从张鲁。太祖定[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，悳随众降。太祖素闻其骁勇，[[拜|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]][[立义将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-148]]，封关门[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，邑三百户。

vern.zht: 後來張白騎在[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.65035856&lng=110.90996505&name=Hongnong]]反叛，龐德又隨馬騰討伐他，在兩座崤山之間擊敗張白騎。每次交戰，龐德常常衝入敵陣、擊退敵人，勇猛爲馬騰軍中第一。後來馬騰被徵召爲衛尉，龐德留下隸屬馬超。太祖在[[渭|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=14]]南擊敗馬超，龐德隨馬超逃入[[漢陽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=26.81209209&lng=104.61455673&name=Hanyang]]，據守[[冀城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=34.70667265&lng=105.41239497&name=Ji]]。龐德後來又隨馬超逃奔[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，依附張魯。太祖平定[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，龐德隨衆投降。太祖一向聽說龐德驍勇，任命龐德爲[[立義將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-148]]，封爲關門[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，食邑三百戶。
vern.zhs: 后来张白骑在[[弘农|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.65035856&lng=110.90996505&name=Hongnong]]反叛，庞德又随马腾讨伐他，在两座崤山之间击败张白骑。每次交战，庞德常常冲入敌阵、击退敌人，勇猛为马腾军中第一。后来马腾被征召为卫尉，庞德留下隶属马超。太祖在[[渭|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=14]]南击败马超，庞德随马超逃入[[汉阳|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=26.81209209&lng=104.61455673&name=Hanyang]]，据守[[冀城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=34.70667265&lng=105.41239497&name=Ji]]。庞德后来又随马超逃奔[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，依附张鲁。太祖平定[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，庞德随众投降。太祖一向听说庞德骁勇，任命庞德为[[立义将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-148]]，封为关门[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]，食邑三百户。

passages.en: Later, when Zhang Baiqi rebelled in [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.65035856&lng=110.90996505&name=Hongnong]], Pang De again accompanied Ma Teng on campaign and defeated Baiqi at Yao Mountain. In every battle, Pang De charged the enemy lines and drove them back, his valour unsurpassed in Ma Teng's army. When Ma Teng was later [[summoned|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] to court as Commandant of the Palace Guards, Pang De remained under Ma Chao. After Cao Cao defeated Ma Chao south of the [[Wei River|/maps/map-overall?water=14]], Pang De fled with him into [[Hanyang|/maps/map-overall?lat=26.81209209&lng=104.61455673&name=Hanyang]] and held [[Ji|/maps/map-overall?lat=34.70667265&lng=105.41239497&name=Ji]]. Pang De then followed Ma Chao to [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]] and served under Zhang Lu. When Cao Cao pacified [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]], Pang De surrendered with the others. Having long heard of his valour, Cao Cao [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] him [[General Who Champions Righteousness|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-148]] and enfeoffed him as [[Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]] of Guanmen, with three hundred households.

orig.zht: 侯音、衞開等以[[宛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]叛，悳將所領與曹仁共攻拔[[宛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]，斬音、開，遂南屯[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，討關羽。[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]下諸將以悳兄在[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，頗疑之。悳常曰：「我受國恩，義在效死。我欲身自擊羽。今年我不殺羽，羽當殺我。」後親與羽交戰，射羽中額。時悳常乘白馬，羽軍謂之白馬將軍，皆憚之。
orig.zhs: 侯音、衞开等以[[宛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]叛，悳将所领与曹仁共攻拔[[宛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]，斩音、开，遂南屯[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，讨关羽。[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]下诸将以悳兄在[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，颇疑之。悳常曰：「我受国恩，义在效死。我欲身自击羽。今年我不杀羽，羽当杀我。」后亲与羽交战，射羽中额。时悳常乘白马，羽军谓之白马将军，皆惮之。

vern.zht: 侯音、衛開等人據[[宛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]城反叛。龐德率領所部與曹仁一同攻克[[宛|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]城，斬殺侯音、衛開，隨後南下駐紮[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，討伐關羽。[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]一帶的將領們因爲龐德的兄長在[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，對他頗有懷疑。龐德常說：“我蒙受國家恩惠，按道義應當效死。我要親自攻擊關羽。今年我不殺關羽，關羽就會殺我。”後來他親自與關羽交戰，射中關羽前額。當時龐德常騎白馬，關羽的軍隊稱他爲“白馬將軍”，都很忌憚他。
vern.zhs: 侯音、卫开等人据[[宛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]城反叛。庞德率领所部与曹仁一同攻克[[宛|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]]城，斩杀侯音、卫开，随后南下驻扎[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，讨伐关羽。[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]一带的将领们因为庞德的兄长在[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，对他颇有怀疑。庞德常说：“我蒙受国家恩惠，按道义应当效死。我要亲自攻击关羽。今年我不杀关羽，关羽就会杀我。”后来他亲自与关羽交战，射中关羽前额。当时庞德常骑白马，关羽的军队称他为“白马将军”，都很忌惮他。

passages.en: When Hou Yin, Wei Kai, and others rebelled at [[Wan|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]], Pang De led his troops and joined Cao Ren in storming and taking [[Wan|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.98790226&lng=112.53739567&name=Wan]], beheading Hou Yin and Wei Kai. He then marched south to garrison at [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] and campaign against Guan Yu. The generals at [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] were deeply suspicious of Pang De because his elder brother was in [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]. Pang De often said, "I have received the state's favour, and ought to give my life in its service. I mean to attack Guan Yu myself. If I do not kill him this year, he will kill me." He later engaged Guan Yu in person and struck him in the forehead with an arrow. Pang De often rode a white horse, so Guan Yu's troops called him the White Horse General and all stood in awe of him.

source.en: Weilüe / Brief History of Wei (Yu Huan)

vern.zht: 《魏略》記載：龐德的堂兄名叫龐柔，當時在蜀地。
vern.zhs: 《魏略》记载：庞德的堂兄名叫庞柔，当时在蜀地。

annotations.en: The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: Pang De's elder cousin, Pang Rou, was then serving in Shu.

orig.zht: 仁使悳屯[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]北十[[里|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-li]]，會天霖雨十餘日，[[漢水|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴溢，[[樊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]下平地五六[[丈|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]，悳與諸將避水上隄。羽乘船攻之，以大船四面射隄上。悳被甲持弓，箭不虛發。將軍董衡、部曲將董超等欲降，悳皆收斬之。
orig.zhs: 仁使悳屯[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]北十[[里|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-li]]，会天霖雨十余日，[[汉水|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴溢，[[樊|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]下平地五六[[丈|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]，悳与诸将避水上隄。羽乘船攻之，以大船四面射隄上。悳被甲持弓，箭不虚发。将军董衡、部曲将董超等欲降，悳皆收斩之。

vern.zht: 曹仁派龐德駐紮在[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]以北十[[里|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-li]]處。適逢連續下了十多天大雨，[[漢水|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴漲氾濫，[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]下的平地水深五六[[丈|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]，龐德與衆將上堤避水。關羽乘船攻打他們，用大船從四面向堤上射箭。龐德身披鎧甲、手持弓，箭不虛發。將軍董衡、部曲將董超等人想投降，龐德把他們都抓起來斬首了。
vern.zhs: 曹仁派庞德驻扎在[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]以北十[[里|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-li]]处。适逢连续下了十多天大雨，[[汉水|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=52]]暴涨泛滥，[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]下的平地水深五六[[丈|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]，庞德与众将上堤避水。关羽乘船攻打他们，用大船从四面向堤上射箭。庞德身披铠甲、手持弓，箭不虚发。将军董衡、部曲将董超等人想投降，庞德把他们都抓起来斩首了。

passages.en: Cao Ren ordered Pang De to encamp ten [[Li|/translations/officials#glossary-li]] north of [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]. Rain then fell incessantly for over ten days, and the [[Han River|/maps/map-overall?water=52]] rose violently, flooding the ground at [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]] to a depth of five or six [[zhang|/translations/officials#glossary-zhang]]. Pang De and his officers took refuge atop an embankment. Guan Yu attacked by boat, his vessels firing arrows from all sides at those on the embankment. Clad in armour and bow in hand, De never missed his mark. When General Dong Heng, retainer commander Dong Chao, and others sought to surrender, Pang De had them all seized and beheaded.

orig.zht: 自平旦力戰至日過中，羽攻益急，矢盡，短兵接戰。悳謂督將成何曰：「吾聞良將不怯死以苟免，烈士不毀節以求生，今日，我死日也。」戰益怒，氣愈壯，而水浸盛，吏士皆降。
orig.zhs: 自平旦力战至日过中，羽攻益急，矢尽，短兵接战。悳谓督将成何曰：「吾闻良将不怯死以苟免，烈士不毁节以求生，今日，我死日也。」战益怒，气愈壮，而水浸盛，吏士皆降。

vern.zht: 從天剛亮起，龐德奮力作戰，一直打到太陽過中天；關羽攻勢更急，龐德的箭用盡了，就以短兵器接戰。龐德對督將成何說：“我聽說良將不因怕死而苟且偷生，志士不毀節操以求活命，今天就是我死的日子。”他越戰越憤怒，氣概越壯，但水勢越來越大，手下將士全部投降了。
vern.zhs: 从天刚亮起，庞德奋力作战，一直打到太阳过中天；关羽攻势更急，庞德的箭用尽了，就以短兵器接战。庞德对督将成何说：“我听说良将不因怕死而苟且偷生，志士不毁节操以求活命，今天就是我死的日子。”他越战越愤怒，气概越壮，但水势越来越大，手下将士全部投降了。

passages.en: Pang De fought with all his might from dawn until after midday, as Guan Yu pressed his attack ever harder. When their arrows were spent, Pang De fought on at close quarters. Pang De said to one of his commanders, Cheng He, "I have heard that a worthy general does not shrink from death merely to save himself, nor does a man of valour sacrifice his integrity to preserve his life. Today is my day to die." He fought with ever greater fury, his spirit rising ever higher. But the floodwaters continued to swell, and all his officers and men surrendered.

orig.zht: 悳與麾下將一人，伍伯二人，彎弓傅矢，乘小船欲還仁營。水盛船覆，失弓矢，獨抱船覆水中，為羽所得，立而不跪。羽謂曰：「卿兄在[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，我欲以卿為將，不早降何為？」悳罵羽曰：「豎子，何謂降也！魏王帶甲百萬，威振天下。汝劉備庸才耳，豈能敵邪！我寧為國家鬼，不為賊將也。」遂為羽所殺。
orig.zhs: 悳与麾下将一人，伍伯二人，弯弓傅矢，乘小船欲还仁营。水盛船覆，失弓矢，独抱船覆水中，为羽所得，立而不跪。羽谓曰：「卿兄在[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，我欲以卿为将，不早降何为？」悳骂羽曰：「竖子，何谓降也！魏王带甲百万，威振天下。汝刘备庸才耳，岂能敌邪！我宁为国家鬼，不为贼将也。」遂为羽所杀。

vern.zht: 龐德與部下一名將領、兩名伍伯彎弓搭箭，乘上小船，準備回曹仁營中。水勢很大，船翻了，弓箭也丟了；龐德獨自抱着翻在水中的船，被關羽俘獲。他站着不跪。關羽對他說：“你的兄長在[[漢中|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，我想任用你爲將領，爲什麼不早些投降呢？”龐德罵關羽說：“小子，說什麼投降！魏王擁有百萬披甲將士，威震天下。你的劉備不過是個庸才罷了，哪能抵擋！我寧肯做國家的鬼，也不做賊人的將領。”於是龐德被關羽殺死。
vern.zhs: 庞德与部下一名将领、两名伍伯弯弓搭箭，乘上小船，准备回曹仁营中。水势很大，船翻了，弓箭也丢了；庞德独自抱着翻在水中的船，被关羽俘获。他站着不跪。关羽对他说：“你的兄长在[[汉中|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=110]]，我想任用你为将领，为什么不早些投降呢？”庞德骂关羽说：“小子，说什么投降！魏王拥有百万披甲将士，威震天下。你的刘备不过是个庸才罢了，哪能抵挡！我宁肯做国家的鬼，也不做贼人的将领。”于是庞德被关羽杀死。

passages.en: Pang De, accompanied by one of his commanders and two squad leaders, bent their bows and nocked their arrows, then boarded a small boat wishing to return to Cao Ren's camp. The swollen waters overturned the boat, and they lost their bows and arrows. Pang De clung to the capsized vessel until Guan Yu's men captured him. He remained standing and refused to kneel. Guan Yu said, "Your elder brother is in [[Hanzhong|/maps/map-overall?admin=110]], and I intend to make you a general. Why did you not surrender sooner?" Pang De reviled him: "Wretch! How dare you speak of surrender? The King of Wei has a million men under arms, and his might shakes the realm. Your Liu Bei is nothing but a mediocrity. How could he hope to rival the king? I would rather die as a ghost of the state than live as a general of rebels!" Guan Yu then had him killed.

orig.zht: 太祖聞而悲之，為之流涕，封其二子為[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。文帝即王位，乃遣使就悳墓賜謚，策曰：「昔先軫喪元，王蠋絕脰，隕身徇節，前代美之。惟侯戎昭果毅，蹈難成名，聲溢當時，義高在昔，寡人愍焉，謚曰壯侯。」又賜子會等四人爵[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]，邑各百戶。會勇烈有父風，官至中尉將軍，封[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。
orig.zhs: 太祖闻而悲之，为之流涕，封其二子为[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。文帝即王位，乃遣使就悳墓赐谥，策曰：「昔先轸丧元，王蠋绝脰，陨身徇节，前代美之。惟侯戎昭果毅，蹈难成名，声溢当时，义高在昔，寡人愍焉，谥曰壮侯。」又赐子会等四人爵[[关内侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]，邑各百户。会勇烈有父风，官至中尉将军，封[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。

vern.zht: 太祖聽說後爲他悲痛，爲他流淚，封他的兩個兒子爲[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。文帝繼承王位後，就派使者到龐德墓前賜給諡號，策書說：“從前先軫失去頭顱，王蠋割斷脖頸，他們犧牲生命、殉於節義，前代人都讚美他們。侯在軍旅中表現出果敢堅毅，身赴危難而成就名聲，聲譽在當時傳揚，義烈高於往昔之人，寡人憐惜他，賜諡號爲壯侯。”又賜給龐德的兒子龐會等四人[[關內侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]爵位，食邑各一百戶。龐會勇猛剛烈，有父親的風範，官至中尉將軍，封爲[[列侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。
vern.zhs: 太祖听说后为他悲痛，为他流泪，封他的两个儿子为[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。文帝继承王位后，就派使者到庞德墓前赐给谥号，策书说：“从前先轸失去头颅，王蠋割断脖颈，他们牺牲生命、殉于节义，前代人都赞美他们。侯在军旅中表现出果敢坚毅，身赴危难而成就名声，声誉在当时传扬，义烈高于往昔之人，寡人怜惜他，赐谥号为壮侯。”又赐给庞德的儿子庞会等四人[[关内侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]]爵位，食邑各一百户。庞会勇猛刚烈，有父亲的风范，官至中尉将军，封为[[列侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]。

passages.en: When Cao Cao heard this, he grieved and wept for Pang De, granting each of his two sons the rank of [[Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]]. When Cao Pi (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wen, the Civil Emperor) succeeded as King of Wei, he sent an envoy to Pang De's tomb to confer a posthumous title. The edict read: "In former times, Xian Zhen lost his head and Wang Zhu cut his own throat. They gave their lives to preserve their integrity, and were praised by earlier ages. The Marquis was radiant in war and resolute in courage. In peril, he won renown, and his fame resounded through our times. His righteousness surpassed that of the ancients. I mourn him and confer upon him the posthumous title Marquis Zhuang, the Valiant Marquis." Emperor Wen also granted his son Pang Hui and three others the rank of [[Marquis Within the Pass|/translations/officials#glossary-marquis-within-the-pass]], each with a fief of one hundred households. Pang Hui was bold and resolute, with his father's spirit. He rose to become Commandant of the Capital and General, and was granted the rank of [[Marquis||/translations/officials#glossary-marquis]].

annotations.zht: 《蜀記》曰：鍾會平蜀，前後鼓吹，迎悳屍喪還葬[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，冢中身首如生。臣松之案悳死於[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，文帝即位，又遣使至悳墓所，則其屍喪不應在蜀。此王隱之虛說也。
annotations.zhs: 《蜀记》曰：钟会平蜀，前后鼓吹，迎悳尸丧还葬[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]，冢中身首如生。臣松之案悳死于[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，文帝即位，又遣使至悳墓所，则其尸丧不应在蜀。此王隐之虚说也。

vern.zht: 王隱的《蜀記》記載：鍾會平定蜀國後，前後都有樂隊吹奏迎接龐德的屍體，運回後，葬在[[鄴|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]地的蒙中，身體和頭顱就像生前一樣。臣裴松之考證：龐德死在[[樊城|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，魏文帝即位後，又派遣使者到龐德的墓地，那麼他的屍體不應該在蜀地，所以王隱《蜀記》裏的說法是虛假的記載。
vern.zhs: 王隐的《蜀记》记载：钟会平定蜀国后，前后都有乐队吹奏迎接庞德的尸体，运回后，葬在[[邺|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]]地的蒙中，身体和头颅就像生前一样。臣裴松之考证：庞德死在[[樊城|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]]，魏文帝即位后，又派遣使者到庞德的墓地，那么他的尸体不应该在蜀地，所以王隐《蜀记》里的说法是虚假的记载。

annotations.en: The Shuji / Record of Shu states: "After Zhong Hui pacified Shu, he received Pang De's remains with musicians before and behind the cortege and returned them to [[Ye|/maps/map-overall?lat=36.29000818&lng=114.3635467&name=Ye]] for burial. In the tomb, Pang De's head and body appeared as lifelike as ever." Your subject Songzhi notes that Pang De died at [[Fancheng|/maps/map-overall?lat=32.04746989&lng=112.06874333&name=Fancheng]], and that when Emperor Wen ascended the throne, he sent an envoy to Pang De's grave. De's remains therefore cannot have been in Shu. Wang Yin's account is false.
